resources.string: When enabled, WAEX saves its own crash types and limited WhatsApp hook startup status reports for up to 7 days (maximum 1.75 MiB). It never collects chats, contacts, media, message IDs, passwords, raw logcat or WhatsApp crash stacks. It does not monitor in the background.
A ZIP stays on this device until you choose a receiving app, select the developer group in Telegram and confirm Send. Review the report first; nothing is uploaded automatically.
